4th Period.workingNow: Practicing our entry routine, learning classroom rules, and getting logged into every tool we'll use this year.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: GitHub repository shared privately with Ms. Herrick, personalized with an index.html and fun details about you.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can walk in and find my seat, log into my Chromebook, Google Classroom, and GitHub so that I'm ready to learn every day this year.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.NI.4 — Model account creation and login practices that protect personal information when accessing networked systems.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.5 — Listening actively to spoken English in a range of social and academic contexts.
agenda: Entry routine: practice walking in & finding seats (5 min)
I do: Classroom rules overview (8 min)
We do: Wayground Non-Negotiables quiz together (12 min)
Get Chromebook, log in, practice put-away (10 min)
Join Google Classroom & sign into GitHub (10 min)
Exit Ticket: name one non-negotiable (5 min)
4th Period.connections: This is our very first day together, so today is just about learning our room and our tools. Tomorrow we'll set our classroom norms and build a first, private example on GitHub.
